title: Agents Foundry — From organization to AI employee
targetContext: Guided QA assignment for an already configured organization with active employees. This is a target, not a measured benchmark; external integration setup is separate.

scenes.title: A new teammate. A clear purpose.
scenes.subtitle: The organizational layer for AI.
scenes.narration: Every growing team has more work than time. Meet Testo, a QA employee in Agents Foundry. Let's give this new teammate a place in your organization.

scenes.title: From new arrival to assigned teammate.
scenes.subtitle: 5–10 minute guided onboarding target.
scenes.narration: With your organization and employee accounts configured, the guided QA onboarding target is five to ten minutes. Follow Testo's arrival.

scenes.title: Every teammate needs a role.
scenes.subtitle: Engineering → QA Engineer
scenes.narration: The administrator chooses the QA Engineer blueprint and the active employees who will receive an agent. A role gives Testo a clear purpose.

scenes.title: Give the role a clear boundary.
scenes.subtitle: Name · scope · environment · enforced capabilities
scenes.narration: Next, name the agent and define its scope, environment, and configuration preferences. Review the enforced capabilities. Testo now has a boundary around the assignment.

scenes.title: One setup. Individual teammates.
scenes.subtitle: Up to 25 active employees per assignment batch.
scenes.narration: One setup can assign distinct instances to up to twenty-five active employees. Each assignment is signed and employee-bound, with its own conversation history.

scenes.title: The right agent. The right owner.
scenes.subtitle: Signature · employee ownership · organization
scenes.narration: The employee verifies the assigned agent. Signature, ownership, and organization checks connect Testo to the right person. The teammate has arrived.

scenes.title: Your people stay in charge.
scenes.subtitle: Plan freely. Review controlled actions.
scenes.narration: Testo supports QA planning. Browser execution needs human approval. Production deployment is denied. Approval grants permission; connected execution is a separate layer on the roadmap.

scenes.title: Build your AI workforce.
scenes.subtitle: Run it like a real organization.
scenes.narration: Start with QA. Explore fifty-five specialist role concepts and the wider workforce vision. Agents Foundry. Build your AI workforce. Run it like a real organization.
